```python
def clamp(x: float, lo: float, hi: float) -> float:
    """把 x 夹到 [lo, hi] 区间。lo<=hi 由调用方保证。"""
    if lo > hi:
        raise ValueError(f'lo({lo}) > hi({hi})')
    return max(lo, min(x, hi))

# tests
assert clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5
assert clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0
assert clamp(99, 0, 10) == 10
```
